title: Week 33: View Transition ✨
content:
Week 33: View Transition ✨

Web Components 🧩

I’ve been looking into Lit — it’s a pretty neat library for building web components. If you’re using TypeScript, you’ll need decorators to get the most out of it.

View Transitions 🎞️

Astro.js now supports View Transitions. It’s a slick way to animate block elements between pages, giving your site a smoother, app-like feel.

3D Stuff 🕶️

d.design → Alibaba’s 3D modeling site, worth checking out!

OGL → a lightweight 3D rendering library that’s super clean and minimal.

Germany 🇩🇪

Found DAAD — a great resource if you’re considering studying in Germany.

Thailand 🇹🇭

If you’re up for learning Thai, Duke Language School in Thailand looks like a solid option.
